issues.problem: Provider text can reconstitute and display the full stored credential after the only redaction pass.
issues.fix: Normalize provider text before redaction, verify credential absence at the boundary before sending a result to the panel, and add a regression with a synthetic marked-up token echo.

issues.problem: An active-game board can become eligible through a review routing hint.
issues.fix: Check active-game signals before accepting review or analysis context, require positive evidence of an eligible board, and add a real-host fixture with conflicting active and review signals that asserts zero requests.

issues.problem: A verified move line can override trustworthy exact castling rights and receive a successful check despite the discrepancy.
issues.fix: Compare available exact position fields against the line, use the exact board as a visible fallback when they conflict, and add a same-placement mainline regression with different rights.

issues.problem: Chess.com misses exposed custom root tags, and skipping an animating main piece can leave an actionable incomplete scan.
issues.fix: Read trusted root metadata or fall back visibly. Wait for a complete stable scan when a main piece is mid-transition, and add full-payload or zero-request fixtures for both cases.

issues.problem: A prose move can drive an agreement verdict using a legality field that belongs to the other provider format.
issues.fix: Select the legality field by configured API shape and add regression coverage for incorrectly placed and conflicting fields in both formats.

issues.problem: Changing a custom server can carry checked authorization to send the stored token to the replacement origin.
issues.fix: Bind consent to the specific normalized origin displayed to the user, clear pending consent on origin changes and after saving, and test replacement without a new opt-in.

issues.problem: The mandatory owner check is an unsigned transcription for an earlier build.
issues.fix: Have the owner perform and sign a 1.0.0 Game Review check that records the selected move, ask type and expected versus observed position.

issues.problem: Closed polling performs adapter layout reads, and the SPA test counts timer markup rather than scheduled timers.
